newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI shares up after half-year profit gain.
newsitem.headline: ICI shares up after half-year profit gain.

text.p: Shares in tightly held ICI Australia Ltd rose more than four percent after the chemical group reported a 19.5 percent rise in first half net profit.
At 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), ICI Australia shares were 54 cents or 4.47 percent up at A$12.63 with about 150,000 shares traded.

ICI Australia, which is 62.4 percent owned by Imperial Chemicals Industries Plc, reported a net profit of A$110.7 million for the six months ended March 31, compared with A$92.6 million a year earlier.
The chemicals group said after the release of the profit that it remained positive about its second half results.
